summary: Set WMS requirements, assess data readiness, and govern implementation risks. Explore the course and plan your warehouse system decision.
lede: Warehouse management system governance connects operating needs, data, integrations, and business outcomes to system decisions. Designed for warehouse managers, supply-chain transformation leads, and ERP or WMS project owners, the course supports the practical task of governing selection and rollout. Participants map processes with BPMN, rank requirements, assess GTIN, GLN, and SSCC data readiness, and plan ERP interfaces, acceptance criteria, and cutover controls.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape WMS decisions, coordinate warehouse implementation work, or oversee system controls and outcomes.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of warehouse or distribution operations and basic ERP or WMS project terminology is recommended. No programming is required; software configuration sits outside the course scope.
